UiProvider.note: ThemeProvider kept in step with the runtime's mode, plus TooltipProvider

TopNav.note: Navbar, brand in its logo slot

NavList.note: NavItems; contract NavLinks become NavItemLinks so its More menu finds them

NavEnd.note: a plain div inside the Navbar

Button.note: Button; href renders the Button as an <a> (asChild)

StatGroup.note: StatPanel; selectable items are filter cards

StatusBadge.note: StatusBadge with an explicit tone and glyph

Badge.note: Badge variants: neutral → secondary / outline, danger → destructive

Slider.note: Slider with one thumb, value shown

Tooltip.note: Tooltip, TooltipTrigger (asChild) and TooltipContent below the element

Select.note: Select with trigger, value and items built from options

Chart.note: the design system's Chart on recharts, chart tokens 1–4; solid points with no outline

Heatmap.note: tiles on the design system's tokens: the first chart colour over the surface in five steps, text at 4.5:1 or better on every step in both themes
